name: marine-monitor-apps
description: Coast-watch receiver: virtual radar, live map, GMDSS alerts and marine weather.
author: BajanBob

scripts.cap:android: npm run copy-www && cap add android && node scripts/patch-android.mjs && capacitor-assets generate --iconBackgroundColor '#06141f' --iconBackgroundColorDark '#06141f' --splashBackgroundColor '#06141f' --splashBackgroundColorDark '#06141f' --android && cap sync android
scripts.cap:ios: npm run copy-www && cap add ios && node scripts/patch-ios.mjs && capacitor-assets generate --iconBackgroundColor '#06141f' --iconBackgroundColorDark '#06141f' --splashBackgroundColor '#06141f' --splashBackgroundColorDark '#06141f' --ios && cap sync ios
scripts.dist:win: npm run copy-www && electron-builder --win nsis portable --x64 --publish never
